record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose to keep the grouped table for All phases. With a phase selected, header rows add nothing, and every row opening a task removes the three meanings Enter had.

## Counter-argument

A flat list with a phase column is one row type everywhere, so the cursor and Enter behave the same on every stop.

payload.alternatives: a flat task list with a phase column on All phases
payload.choice: Collapsible phase sections, with older done phases folded, appear only on the All phases stop; a selected phase lists its tasks with no header rows

record.subject: phase-sections
